title: OntoRAG content chunk
description: One line of a content/chunks/*.jsonl file. A retrievable unit of source text, linked to ontology entities.

id.description: Globally unique chunk id; also the join key to its embedding record. Convention: '<doc_slug>::<seq>'.

doc.description: Source document slug (matches an entry in content/sources.json).

seq.description: 0-based position of the chunk within its document.

heading_path.description: Breadcrumb of markdown headings (H1..Hn) above this chunk, outermost first.

text.description: The chunk's plain text, used both for retrieval display and as embedding input.

entities.description: IRIs of ontology entities mentioned in this chunk (the ontology↔content link that makes retrieval graph-aware).
